form.targetHint: Without a goal, the card shows only the balance. Reaching the goal does not block a deposit.

deactivate.title: Deactivate "{{name}}"?
deactivate.description: The saved balance keeps counting in the total and its history stays — what it stops accepting is new deposits and withdrawals. If the idea was to close it, withdraw the balance first.

activate.title: Reactivate "{{name}}"?
activate.description: The cashbox goes back to accepting deposits and withdrawals. Its balance and history do not change.

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.blockedDescription: The cashbox still has a balance. Deleting is only allowed with a zero balance — deactivate it instead, or withdraw the balance and try again.

empty.title: No cashboxes yet
empty.description: A cashbox sets aside money that is still in an account but already has a purpose — a vacation, renovations, an emergency fund. Saving is not spending, so none of it counts as an expense.

error.title: Could not load the cashboxes
error.description: Check your connection and try again.

summary.note: Recurrences are generated when you log in — the app checks the current date against pending rules and materializes what is missing.

generate.nothingDescription: This rule is already materialized up to {{date}}.

deactivate.title: Deactivate "{{name}}"?
deactivate.description: Entries already generated stay where they are and keep counting in the balance and reports. What stops is generation from here on.

cancelInstallments.title: Cancel "{{name}}"?
cancelInstallments.description: This removes installments scheduled after today. Installments dated today or earlier stay.

empty.title: No recurrences yet
empty.description: A rule generates by itself whatever repeats every month — income, insurance, a subscription — and an installment plan splits a purchase into the payments it will have. Either way, you fill it in once.

error.title: Could not load the recurrences
error.description: Check your connection and try again.

preview.title: Preview
preview.notPersisted: nothing is saved until you save
preview.clamped: {{count}} of {{total}} occurrences fall on the last day of the month.

ruleForm.amountHintVariable: No fixed amount: entries are created as a draft until you fill it in.
ruleForm.endHint: Left blank, the rule never ends.
ruleForm.autoConfirmHint: Off, installments are created as drafts.
ruleForm.editNotice: Changing the amount later only applies to what has not been generated yet. What is already in the history stays as it is.
ruleForm.invalidDayOfMonth: The day must be between 1 and 31.
ruleForm.endBeforeStart: The end cannot be before the start.

installmentForm.purchaseDateHint: Kept in the notes; neither date field preserves it.
installmentForm.firstPaymentDateHint: The date the installment lands on the statement — and the month it shows up in the report.
installmentForm.autoConfirmHint: Off, the installments are created as a draft.
installmentForm.notice: The {{count}} installments are saved now, all at once — not just the next few months'. That is what makes the future commitment show up in the yearly report on the day the purchase happens.
